featured.name: Route66
featured.info: Gas Station Price Tracking Mobile App

description.description: A mobile application that allows users to locate gas stations & track their prices in Cebu using interactive map markers

detail.description: Users can view the map of Cebu with pins displayed marking gas stations, showing the fuel and price details of selected gas station markers.
Users can navigate to selected gas stations and see the best route from their location.
Users can search for all gas stations by location, brand and name as well as filter their gasoline types and proximity.
Users are notificed when gas stations update their price on specific fuels, and can see whether the price has increased or decreased from the original price.
Users ask for suggestions for the Route 66 Assistant to help them find gas stations based on specific questions like a balance of proximity and price, cheapest diesel, etc.
